entries.reason: `IF WS-CICS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)` at 132, after `EXEC CICS DELAY FOR SECONDS(WS-DELAY-AMT)`: WS-DELAY-AMT is `COMPUTE ((3 - 1) * FUNCTION RANDOM(WS-SEED)) + 1` into a PIC S9(8) COMP, and RANDOM is below 1, so the interval is always 1 or 2 seconds. IBM's DELAY conditions (https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/cics-ts/6.x?topic=summary-delay) are EXPIRED (a time already past; intervals under 250 ms), and INVREQ for hours, minutes, seconds or milliseconds out of range (RESP2 4, 5, 6, 22) or a command CICS cannot process; a FOR SECONDS of 1 or 2 meets none (no HOURS/MINUTES/MILLISECONDS operand, no TIME/UNTIL), and the harness plans no fault on DELAY. The paragraphs this arm PERFORMs (POPULATE-TIME-DATE, PTD010, PTD999) are reachable only through it: they stay uncovered, as this ledger states branches, not paragraphs.

`IF WS-CICS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)` at 233, after `EXEC CICS PUT CONTAINER(WS-CONTAINER-NAME) FROM(WS-CONT-IN) FLENGTH(WS-CONTAINER-LEN) CHANNEL(WS-CHANNEL-NAME)`: the container name ('CIPA') and channel name are MOVEd constants (valid names: no CONTAINERERR 18, no CHANNELERR 1), FLENGTH is `LENGTH OF WS-CONT-IN` (positive: no LENGERR 1), and the command carries no DATATYPE, FROMCCSID or FROMCODEPAGE (no INVREQ 1, 2, 32, 34, no CCSIDERR, no CODEPAGEERR); it follows a GET CONTAINER of the same container and channel that returned NORMAL (the container exists with its own data type, so no INVREQ 33, and it is not CICS-defined: no INVREQ 30). IBM's PUT CONTAINER (CHANNEL) conditions (https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/cics-ts/6.x?topic=summary-put-container-channel) are exactly those; the one left is CHANNELERR RESP2 3, a read-only channel, and the channel here is the one CRECUST built by PUT CONTAINER and passed on RUN TRANSID CHANNEL, which is writable (a read-only channel is IBM's case for CICS-supplied channels). Assumption to review: CHANNELERR 3.
